name: memory_compile_skill
description: Compile, test, or dry-run a procedural skill (playbook or heuristic) from episodic turns or semantic memories through the SkillPathway (ADR-0086). In DRY_RUN mode (commit=false), generates the spector.skill.v1 preview and checks for near-duplicates without persisting. In COMPILE mode (commit=true), persists to procedural memory with full lineage.

parents.description: List of parent memory TSIDs (episodic conversation turns or semantic facts) to crystallize into a skill.

parent_texts.description: Optional explicit observation texts or procedure steps if parents are not pre-indexed.

cue.description: Optional name, invocation cue, or intent for the procedural skill.

commit.description: If true, persists the skill to procedural memory. If false (default), performs a dry-run preview and dedup check without persisting.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace. Omit to use connection default.
